page.layout: One column of running text under a centred running head. A section heading stands mid-page. No margin notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Baptizatos ab orthodoxis, rebaptizandos dicunt Nouatiani, Arriani, Aetiani, Donatistæ.
Baptisma etiam in suis à se baptizatis sæpius repetunt Marcionitæ, Nouatiani, Cathari, Ana-baptistæ.
Pro mortuis catechumenis alios substituunt baptizandos, Marcionitæ.
main_text.head: De Eucharistia siue Cœna Domini.
main_text.p: Cœnam Domini, vt Pascha antiquum, diei decimæquartæ mensis astringunt Quartideci-mani, Floriani.
In Cœna Domini signa necessaria negant A-scodrutæ.
Signa tollunt, & transsubstantiant in re ipsam signatam Papistæ.
Vinum damnant, & eius usum in Cœna Domini Seueriani.
Aquam pro vino. in Eucharistia substituunt Tatiani, Encratitæ, Aquarii[?].
Pane Cœnæ Domini sanguini humano per-miscent Cataphryges, Pepuziani:
Panem non esse carnis, sed diuinitatis Christi signum, dicunt Armenii.
Azymo pane præcisè & necessariò in Cœna Domini utendum esse dicunt Armenii.

page.notes: Running head and catchword as printed. No page number is printed. "Aquarii" is read from a glyph like y/j and is doubtful. "Pane" may carry an accent that is faint on the scan. The initial "ytendum" is read as "utendum" from the u/v rule. The initial "N" and "M" of several names are decorated letters, read as printed. Some words near the foot show faint stains, not text.
